purpose: Teach: 非課税/管区/掌握/発現/短調/寛大/トップクラス/発効

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 非課税枠を活用しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're taking full advantage of the tax-free allowance.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Professional but not stiff. Forward-moving energy — this is the plan, let's execute it. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業管区別の業績を比較します
lines.en: Got it. I'll compare the sales performance by region.
lines.style: Attentive and responsive. Quick acknowledgment on 'Got it' — showing he's tracking. Businesslike but not robotic. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: シェアの掌握には時間がかかりますね
lines.en: Getting a handle on market share — that's going to take time.
lines.style: Measured, realistic. Slight pause before the dash, as if she's thinking it through out loud. Not pessimistic, just honest about the timeline. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新ブランドの認知が発現するまで広告を続けます
lines.en: Right. We'll keep the ads running until the new brand recognition starts showing up.
lines.style: Confirming and strategic. Clear on the reasoning. Not hesitant — this is the plan he's locking in. Steady, professional delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内BGMを短調系で落ち着かせましょう
lines.en: Let's switch the office background music to something in a minor key — help people settle down.
lines.style: Thoughtful directive. She's considering the human detail. Not commanding, suggesting. Quiet conviction that this matters. Slightly softer than the first line.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。寛大な姿勢でクレーム対応します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we handle complaints with patience and generosity.
lines.style: Responsive and grounded. He understands the principle behind the directive. Clear and capable. Not just complying — endorsing the approach.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界トップクラスを目指しましょう
lines.en: Our goal is to be top tier in this industry.
lines.style: Declarative and ambitious. Firm, confident opening. This is the north star. Not boastful — factual about the target. Steady resolve.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。改正法の発効に備えます
lines.en: Yes. We'll be ready for when the new regulations take effect.
lines.style: Conclusive and prepared. The final confirmation — slight sense of closure in the delivery. Capable, no doubt. Lands the statement with quiet confidence.
